representation.declared: controlled RGB arm: the SAME loader RAW values of this acquisition passed through one fixed, declared ISP (no per-frame statistics): clip(x / input_scale, 0, 1), per-channel gain, gamma encoding, 8-bit quantisation, then /255 back to float32. This is not the official normal-light paired RGB.

model.disclosure: ConvNeXt V2-Base (depths 3/3/27/3, dims 128/256/512/1024) raw backbone initialised from scratch, no RGB weights and no RGB teacher; the 1x1 per-level projection to d_model and the inference proposal/corrector layers are the disclosed new layers; the readout is the ported Perceiver IO core; the RGB arm feeds the identical backbone with the fixed-ISP transform of the same RAW

data.normalisation: loader statistics only, LIBERO quantile statistics with the author gripper rule; the training entry never normalises or de-normalises actions

protocol.unit_note: the 92-dim simulator state never enters the policy; only the 8-dim proprio does

aux.noise_note: the official LIBERO cache declares no sensor noise model, so the noise term stays off

loop.profile_note: profiled on the deployment host before the long run: 25-update pilot at microbatch 1 anchor / grad_accum 1 gave 2.73 s per update (p50 2.53, p95 3.26) and 59.5 GB peak GPU; the run therefore uses microbatch 1 anchor with grad_accum 2 (effective 2 anchors per update, about 5.5 s per update, 1000 updates about 1.5 h) and one process per GPU. The 200-update profile run recorded the chosen setting's real time and memory in its own run directory.

runtime.gpu_note: one process per GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 for this RAW arm, in-process device cuda:0
